items.information: Third year in a row, Rexburg is holding another competition. This competition is designed to help people qualify for the CubingUSA Nationals. We do ask you to limit the number of spectators due to the size of the room.

items.information: Riga Open is the biggest 1 day speedcubing competition in the Baltic countries. Next competition will be held on 28 April in Riga. 6 disciplines where you can take part yourself or see Latvian best speedcubers. The event takes place for 1 days and the participation cost is 5 EUR. If you participate only in 3x3 event, participation is for free.

items.name: Three Seconds Snakes 2018
items.information: The competitor limit is 80. The registration fee is $20. The venue is located at Peter J. Palombi Middle School. If you register and cannot attend, please contact us immediately. If you contact us before April 14th, you will be elligeble for a full refund. However, If you contact us after April 14th you will only be elligeble for a 50% refund.

items.name: U.R.A. Spring of Colors 2018
items.information: Competitor entry fee: 25 RON / Family Saturday, will order pizza for lunch. The fee collector will ask you about pizza and you can give him the order. The pizza will be payed separated. At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize. More details on http://www.speedcubing.ro/u-r-a-spring-of-colors-2018/ Prizes Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event and for the fastest girl, youngest competitor, oldest competitor and fastest competitor of each country (who register until 14.04.2018).

items.information: Registration info * Registration opens on Monday, 12th February, 12:00am (GMT+8). * The steps for registration are as follows: 1. [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/USMPenangCube2018/register) 2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-usmpenangcube2018) according the events you registered. 3. [Email us](mailto:mycubeassociation@gmail.com) the receipt with: i) First Timer - Photocopy of NRIC/Passport with name, nationality and DOB. ii) Returner - WCA ID, with name. 4. Once we have verify your details confirm the correct payment, we will accept your registration. **Kindly check the [payment page](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-usmpenangcube2018) for the payment method. Payment which does not match with the event registered will be recognise as 'Incomplete registration'**
